title: Confucius: Benevolence and Rites
synopsis: The thought of Confucius has shaped China and all of East Asia, forming one of the world's most important philosophical traditions. However, over the millennia many of the interpretations of his philosophies have strayed from what he actualy thought. Find out about two concepts that lie at the very heart of Confucian philosophy in this lesson.

fullText.simplified:
孔子：仁和礼

    越是有名的事物越容易被误解，作为儒家思想的代表人物，孔子也不例外。在美国，最高法院大楼上有孔子的浮雕，象征着古代智慧对法律制度的影响；在中国，有人认为他是封建思想的代表，将儒家思想视为束缚。然而，孔子的真实思想或许与这些印象并不完全相符。
    孔子出生于公元前551年的鲁国。那时，周朝的礼乐制度逐渐衰落，诸侯之间战争频繁。孔子希望找到解决问题的方法，于是15岁开始求学，广泛向名师请教，并在30岁时开始收徒讲学。为了实现政治理想，他带着学生们周游列国，游说各国君主，却未被统治者重用。晚年，他回到鲁国，专注于教育和整理古代文献。他的学生记录整理了他的言论，编成《论语》，使他的思想在后世广为流传。他本人也被尊为“万世师表”——教育的典范。
    《论语》内容丰富，后世学者在其基础上进一步发展，形成了完整的儒家思想体系。孔子是儒家的鼻祖和代表。虽然孔子思想丰富，研究颇多，但可以归纳为两个核心概念：仁和礼。
    “仁”是孔子思想的核心，它强调人与人之间的关系。孔子认为人际交往应该遵循“己所不欲，勿施于人”的原则，即自己不愿接受的事物，不要强加给他人。同时，要学会换位思考，以维持人与人之间的和谐关系。此外，孔子还强调“仁”不仅仅是一种消极的不伤害他人的行为，更是一种积极的、关爱他人的态度。在治理国家方面，孔子认为君主应该“修己以安百姓”，也就是修养自己，用仁爱去影响百姓，而不是单纯依靠法律的约束。
    “礼”是孔子思想中理想社会的典范。这是一整套社会行为准则，包括伦理规范、社会秩序以及人与人之间的行为标准。孔子认为，社会的稳定需要每个人在适当的位置上履行自己的责任。例如，子女应孝顺父母，臣子应忠于君主，各个阶层都应遵守相应的行为准则，以维护社会秩序。然而，孔子的“礼”并不是一种固定不变的规则，而是一种动态的道德体系。他认为，父母应该以德行影响子女，子女进而孝敬父母。这是一种互相尊重、关爱的正向循环。如果父母犯了错误，子女应当恭敬地劝谏，而不是盲目地服从。后世对儒家孝道的理解有时较为片面，只强调子女的义务，而忽略了父母的责任。
    总的来说，孔子的思想远比简单的“守礼”或“强调秩序”更有深度。他不仅关注社会秩序，更强调人与人之间的相互关爱和道德责任。他的影响力持续至今，不仅塑造了中国文化，也对东亚乃至世界的思想体系产生了深远影响。近年的研究还表明，孔子本人身材高大，因此你可以想象这样一个画面：一个身材高大的长者，微笑着对你说：“做人要善良，要遵守规则。”
fullText.traditional:
孔子：仁和禮

    越是有名的事物越容易被誤解，作為儒家思想的代表人物，孔子也不例外。在美國，最高法院大樓上有孔子的浮雕，象徵著古代智慧對法律制度的影響；在中國，有人認為他是封建思想的代表，將儒家思想視為束縛。然而，孔子的真實思想或許與這些印象並不完全相符。
    孔子出生於公元前551年的魯國。那時，周朝的禮樂制度逐漸衰落，諸侯之間戰爭頻繁。孔子希望找到解決問題的方法，於是15歲開始求學，廣泛向名師請教，並在30歲時開始收徒講學。為了實現政治理想，他帶著學生們周遊列國，遊說各國君主，卻未被統治者重用。晚年，他回到魯國，專注於教育和整理古代文獻。他的學生記錄整理了他的言論，編成《論語》，使他的思想在後世廣為流傳。他本人也被尊為“萬世師表”——教育的典範。
    《論語》內容豐富，後世學者在其基礎上進一步發展，形成了完整的儒家思想體系。孔子是儒家的鼻祖和代表。雖然孔子思想豐富，研究頗多，但可以歸納為兩個核心概念：仁和禮。
    “仁”是孔子思想的核心，它強調人與人之間的關係。孔子認為人際交往應該遵循“己所不欲，勿施於人”的原則，即自己不願接受的事物，不要強加給他人。同時，要學會換位思考，以維持人與人之間的和諧關係。此外，孔子還強調“仁”不僅僅是一種消極的不傷害他人的行為，更是一種積極的、關愛他人的態度。在治理國家方面，孔子認為君主應該“修己以安百姓”，也就是修養自己，用仁愛去影響百姓，而不是單純依靠法律的約束。
    “禮”是孔子思想中理想社會的典範。這是一整套社會行為準則，包括倫理規範、社會秩序以及人與人之間的行為標準。孔子認為，社會的穩定需要每個人在適當的位置上履行自己的責任。例如，子女應孝順父母，臣子應忠於君主，各個階層都應遵守相應的行為準則，以維護社會秩序。然而，孔子的“禮”並不是一種固定不變的規則，而是一種動態的道德體系。他認為，父母應該以德行影響子女，子女進而孝敬父母。這是一種互相尊重、關愛的正向循環。如果父母犯了錯誤，子女應當恭敬地勸諫，而不是盲目地服從。後世對儒家孝道的理解有時較為片面，只強調子女的義務，而忽略了父母的責任。
    總的來說，孔子的思想遠比簡單的“守禮”或“強調秩序”更有深度。他不僅關注社會秩序，更強調人與人之間的相互關愛和道德責任。他的影響力持續至今，不僅塑造了中國文化，也對東亞乃至世界的思想體系產生了深遠影響。近年的研究還表明，孔子本人身材高大，因此你可以想像這樣一個畫面：一個身材高大的長者，微笑著對你說：“做人要善良，要遵守規則。”

sentences.english: Confucius believed that social stability requires everyone to fulfill the responsibilities appropriate to their position.

sentences.simplified: 各个阶层都应遵守相应的行为准则，以维护社会秩序。
sentences.traditional: 各個階層都應遵守相應的行為準則，以維護社會秩序。
sentences.pinyin: gè gè jiē céng dōu yīng zūn shǒu xiāng yìng de xíng wéi zhǔn zé yǐ wéi hù shè huì zhì xù
sentences.english: For example, children should be filial to their parents, ministers should be loyal to their monarch, ..

sentences.simplified: 然而，孔子的“礼”并不是一种固定不变的规则，而是一种动态的道德体系。
sentences.traditional: 然而，孔子的“禮”並不是一種固定不變的規則，而是一種動態的道德體系。
sentences.pinyin: rán ér kǒng zǐ de lǐ bìng bù shì yì zhǒng gù dìng bú biàn de guī zé ér shì yì zhǒng dòng tài de dào dé tǐ xì
sentences.english: .. and all social classes should adhere to their respective codes of conduct to maintain social order.

sentences.simplified: 他认为，父母应该以德行影响子女，子女进而孝敬父母。
sentences.traditional: 他認為，父母應該以德行影響子女，子女進而孝敬父母。
sentences.pinyin: tā rèn wéi fù mǔ yīng gāi yǐ dé xing yǐng xiǎng zǐ nǚ zǐ nǚ jìn ér xiào jìng fù mǔ
sentences.english: However, Confucius’s concept of “rites” is not a fixed set of rules, but a dynamic moral system.

sentences.simplified: 这是一种互相尊重、关爱的正向循环。
sentences.traditional: 這是一種互相尊重、關愛的正向循環。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shì yì zhǒng hù xiāng zūn zhòng guān ài de zhèng xiàng xún huán
sentences.english: He believed that parents should influence their children with virtue, and in turn, children should show filial respect to their parents.

sentences.simplified: 如果父母犯了错误，子女应当恭敬地劝谏，而不是盲目地服从。
sentences.traditional: 如果父母犯了錯誤，子女應當恭敬地勸諫，而不是盲目地服從。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ fù mǔ fàn le cuò wù zǐ nǚ yīng dāng gōng jìng de quàn jiàn ér bú shì máng mù de fú cóng
sentences.english: This is a positive cycle of mutual respect and care.

sentences.simplified: 后世对儒家孝道的理解有时较为片面，
sentences.traditional: 後世對儒家孝道的理解有時較為片面，
sentences.pinyin: hòu shì duì rú jiā xiào dao de lǐ jiě yǒu shí jiào wéi piàn miàn
sentences.english: If parents make mistakes, children should respectfully admonish them rather than blindly obeying.

sentences.simplified: 只强调子女的义务，而忽略了父母的责任。
sentences.traditional: 只強調子女的義務，而忽略了父母的責任。
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ qiáng diào zǐ nǚ de yì wù ér hū lüè le fù mǔ de zé rèn
sentences.english: Later generations’ understanding of Confucian filial piety was sometimes rather one-sided.
It only emphasized the obligations of children while neglecting the responsibilities of parents.

sentences.simplified: 总的来说，孔子的思想远比简单的“守礼”或“强调秩序”更有深度。
sentences.traditional: 總的來說，孔子的思想遠比簡單的“守禮”或“強調秩序”更有深度。
sentences.pinyin: zǒng de lái shuō kǒng zǐ de sī xiǎng yuǎn bǐ jiǎn dān de shǒu lǐ huò qiáng diào zhì xù gèng yǒu shēn dù

sentences.simplified: 他不仅关注社会秩序，更强调人与人之间的相互关爱和道德责任。
sentences.traditional: 他不僅關注社會秩序，更強調人與人之間的相互關愛和道德責任。
sentences.pinyin: tā bù jǐn guān zhù shè huì zhì xù gèng qiáng diào rén yǔ rén zhī jiān de xiāng hù guān ài hé dào dé zé rèn
sentences.english: Overall, Confucius’s thought is far deeper than simply “observing rituals” or “emphasizing order.”

sentences.simplified: 他的影响力持续至今，
sentences.traditional: 他的影響力持續至今，
sentences.pinyin: tā de yǐng xiǎng lì chí xù zhì jīn
sentences.english: He not only focused on social order but also emphasized mutual care and moral responsibility between people.

sentences.simplified: 不仅塑造了中国文化，也对东亚乃至世界的思想体系产生了深远影响。
sentences.traditional: 不僅塑造了中國文化，也對東亞乃至世界的思想體系產生了深遠影響。
sentences.pinyin: bù jǐn sù zào le zhōng guó wén huà yě duì dōng yà nǎi zhì shì jiè de sī xiǎng tǐ xì chǎn shēng le shēn yuǎn yǐng xiǎng
sentences.english: His influence continues to this day.

sentences.simplified: 近年的研究还表明，孔子本人身材高大，因此你可以想象这样一个画面：
sentences.traditional: 近年的研究還表明，孔子本人身材高大，因此你可以想像這樣一個畫面：
sentences.pinyin: jìn nián de yán jiū hái biǎo míng kǒng zǐ běn rén shēn cái gāo dà yīn cǐ nǐ kě yǐ xiǎng xiàng zhè yàng yí ge huà miàn
sentences.english: He not only shaped Chinese culture but also had a profound impact on the philosophical systems of East Asia and even the world.

sentences.simplified: 一个身材高大的长者，微笑着对你说：“做人要善良，要遵守规则。”
sentences.traditional: 一個身材高大的長者，微笑著對你說：“做人要善良，要遵守規則。”
sentences.pinyin: yí ge shēn cái gāo dà de zhǎng zhě wēi xiào zhe duì nǐ shuō zuò rén yào shàn liáng yào zūn shǒu guī zé
sentences.english: Recent studies have also shown that Confucius was tall, so you can imagine this scene:

sentence_translations: Confucius: Benevolence and Rites
The more famous something is, the more likely it is to be misunderstood.
Confucius, as the representative figure of Confucian thought, is no exception.
In the United States, there is a relief of Confucius on the Supreme Court building, ..
.. symbolizing the influence of ancient wisdom on the legal system.
In China, some people consider him a representative of feudal thought and view Confucianism as a constraint.
However, Confucius’ true philosophy may not completely align with these impressions.
Confucius was born in 551 BC in the State of Lu.
At that time, the Zhou Dynasty system of rites and music was gradually declining, and wars broke out frequently between the feudal lords.
Confucius hoped to find solutions to these problems, so he began studying at the age of fifteen.
He sought advice from renowned teachers and started accepting disciples and teaching at the age of thirty.
In order to realize his political ideals, he traveled around the various states with his students, ..
.. lobbying the monarchs of each state in turn, but he was not given an important position by any of the rulers.
In his later years, he returned to the State of Lu, focusing on education and the compilation of ancient texts.
His students recorded and organized his teachings, compiling them into the “Analects”, ..
.. which allowed his thoughts to be widely disseminated in later generations.
He himself is also revered as the “model teacher of every age”—an exemplar of education.
The “Analects” is rich in content, and later scholars built upon its foundation, forming a complete system of Confucian thought.
Confucius is the founder and representative of Confucianism.
Although Confucius’ thought is rich and extensively studied, it can be summarized into two core concepts: benevolence and rites.
“Benevolence” is the core of Confucius’ thought and emphasizes interpersonal relationships.
Confucius believed that interpersonal relations should follow the principle of “Do as you would be done by”.
This means not to impose on others what you do not desire for yourself.
At the same time, you must learn to put yourself in others’ shoes to maintain harmonious relationships with them.
In addition, Confucius also emphasized that “benevolence” is not merely a passive behavior of not harming others, ..
.. but rather an active attitude of caring for others.
In terms of governing the country, Confucius believed that rulers should “cultivate themselves to bring peace to the people”.
This means that one should cultivate oneself and use benevolence to influence the people, ..
.. rather than relying solely on the constraints of laws.
“Rites” are a model for an ideal society in Confucius’ thought.
This is a complete set of norms for social behavior, including ethical standards, social order, and standards of interpersonal conduct.
Confucius believed that social stability requires everyone to fulfill the responsibilities appropriate to their position.
For example, children should be filial to their parents, ministers should be loyal to their monarch, ..
.. and all social classes should adhere to their respective codes of conduct to maintain social order.
However, Confucius’s concept of “rites” is not a fixed set of rules, but a dynamic moral system.
He believed that parents should influence their children with virtue, and in turn, children should show filial respect to their parents.
This is a positive cycle of mutual respect and care.
If parents make mistakes, children should respectfully admonish them rather than blindly obeying.
Later generations’ understanding of Confucian filial piety was sometimes rather one-sided.
It only emphasized the obligations of children while neglecting the responsibilities of parents.
Overall, Confucius’s thought is far deeper than simply “observing rituals” or “emphasizing order.”
He not only focused on social order but also emphasized mutual care and moral responsibility between people.
His influence continues to this day.
He not only shaped Chinese culture but also had a profound impact on the philosophical systems of East Asia and even the world.
